implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/pages/AgentsPage.tsx: Workers table view. Sortable columns: name (text), pool (text), status (StatusBadge), capabilities (Badge list), active/capacity (text with color), last heartbeat (relative time), uptime (duration format), version (text). Client-side sort: click column header toggles asc/desc, visual sort indicator (arrow). Filter section above table: pool dropdown (Select component, options from distinct pools in data), status multi-select (online/offline/draining). Empty state for no workers or no filter matches. Uses useWorkers() hook.
implementationPlan.note: Built AgentsPage with sortable table (8 columns), pool/status filter dropdowns, status badges, relative time for heartbeat, uptime formatting, load highlighting (red at capacity), and dual empty states (no workers / no filter matches).
